dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "app.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for Flask, PyArrow, and praktika to ensure dependency stability. pip and ci are not included as they're environment tools. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets default command to run app.py.
